entities.summary: Lino Esterino Garavaglia, OFM Cap. was an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church. He was ordained as a priest in 1954, and served in multiple positions in Italy for the next thirty years. From the 1980s to the 2000s he served as the bishop of the dioceses of Tivoli and Cesena-Sarsina.
